changes: The fixed-interval weather-window screen is documented using the existing public illustrative record.
The failed continuous-duration criterion is separated from accepted exposure, and the rounding boundary is demonstrated.
Required environmental and installation inputs are identified so that the screening result is not treated as installation acceptance.
Chart criteria use unrounded values and preserve input precision so that displayed rounding cannot change a decision.
Wave-height axis labels match their plotted coordinates; percentile attribution and operation-start wording are corrected.
The rebuild check compares all calculation metadata, and shared ignore rules support adjacent module reports.
Saving records the exact written snapshot so comments added during a write retain the unsaved warning.
Folder and file loading retain current comments when edits occur during a read, including edits saved before the read completes.
